division_exclusion.rule: protocol rev 34: a report of the Health and Medicine Division is not a candidate; protocol rev 34 (extended 2026-10-21): nor is a report listed under any unit whose remit is human health or medicine; a report listed under several units is excluded if any one of them is excluded
division_exclusion.how_recorded: the catalogue's own 'unit' filter, one listing query per unit; every unit of the Health and Medicine Division and every unit whose name contains 'Health' or 'Medicine' is queried and classified (units[code].classification); a report on any excluded unit's listing is excluded and the units are recorded with it
